# Workspace Instructions

## Project

University Portal Documentation Module built with Vanilla JS, HTML, CSS, and a lightweight Node static server.

## Goals

- Preserve the PDF screen structure as closely as possible.
- Keep the implementation framework-free.
- Prefer reusable screen data and minimal, focused edits.
- Keep the layout responsive and polished on desktop and mobile.

## Working Style

- Use the current workspace root for all edits and commands.
- Prefer apply_patch for code changes.
- Keep README and setup files aligned with the current implementation.
- Avoid adding dependencies unless they clearly simplify the requested UI work.
